title: The Accountant: Money Manager
short: Track spending, budgets, loans & savings, with AI, voice entry and privacy mode
full:
Take control of your money with The Accountant — a local-first personal finance app that keeps everyday money management simple, clear and private.

TRACK EVERY TRANSACTION
Log income, expenses and transfers with categories, sub-categories, notes and payment methods. Say it out loud with voice entry, or set up recurring transactions that add themselves.

WALLETS & 160+ CURRENCIES
Keep separate wallets for cash, bank, business or family. Move money between them and see balances in more than 160 currencies with live exchange rates.

BUDGETS THAT KEEP YOU ON TRACK
Set daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or custom budgets and get an alert before you hit the limit.

LOANS — LENT & BORROWED
Record money you lent or borrowed, log partial repayments and always see exactly what's left.

CASH-FLOW FORECAST
See where your balance is heading and get warned before you run short.

SUBSCRIPTIONS, CARDS & BILLS
Keep subscriptions, credit cards and bills in one place, with reminders before they're due.

GOALS, PLANS & NET WORTH
Savings goals linked to your wallets, EMI and installment plans, DPS and fixed deposits, investments with buys and sells, and a net worth view that includes your other assets.

SPLIT BILLS & ZAKAT
Split shared expenses with friends, and work out your zakat with the built-in calculator — or switch it off if it isn't for you.

REPORTS & INSIGHTS
Interactive charts by category, income vs. spending and trends over time. Tap any category to see every transaction behind it.

AI THAT ACTUALLY HELPS
  - AI assistant: ask about your money in plain words. It can add or edit records, and always asks you to confirm first.
  - Spending insights: a monthly review whenever you ask for it.
  - Receipt scanner: snap a receipt and let AI fill in the details.
  - Smart categorization: AI suggests the right category for you.
Everyone gets 10 free AI requests a month, plus extra by watching a short ad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your data lives on your device first; cloud sync is optional. Hide your balances with privacy mode, lock the app with your fingerprint or face, and back up to your own Google Drive for free.

A CALM, MODERN LOOK
A clean, warm design in light and dark mode, with six colour themes to choose from.

YOUR LANGUAGE
Available in English, Bangla, Hindi, German, French, Portuguese, Persian, Malay, Swahili and Amharic.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Wallets, budgets, loans, goals, backups and CSV import/export are free, with no limits. Premium — monthly, yearly (save about 44%) or lifetime — adds more AI, cloud sync across devices, PDF reports and five premium themes.

Download The Accountant today and start making smarter money decisions.
